name: sqlfrontend-tests-scriptdom-error-positions
body: TestMiddleBatchErrorRecovers asserts the exact original-file position ScriptDom 180.140.0's TSql170Parser reports for its stray ')' (line 4, column 23), and TestMySqlDialectRejected asserts line 3 for each MySQL batch; these positions are the parser's current behaviour, not a contract. Recheck and update the expected positions whenever the ScriptDom package version changes.
